title: The Warmest Bun on the Rainy Tray
youtube_title: The Warmest Bun on the Rainy Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is saving the best warmth for the person still out in the weather.
summary: On a rainy day Bea saves the warmest bun from the tray for Mr. Sato, the mail carrier, instead of keeping it for herself.
